title: Design, synthesis and molecular modeling of new coumarin–thiazole derivatives as dual EGFR/HDAC1 inhibitors: in vitro and in vivo anticancer assays
content:

The growing evidence ascertaining the overexpression of EGFR and HDAC1 in breast and colorectal cancers prompted us to design and synthesize some new coumarin–thiazole derivatives with dual EGFR/HDAC1 inhibitory activity.
